last_outcome: P8.5 tavern sign + lamp posts shipped — `src/world/decorations.ts` exports `buildTavernSign(gridOffset)` + `buildLampPosts(gridOffset)` + `updateLampPosts(lamps, phase)` + `lampIntensityForPhase(phase)`. Sign is a 1.5×0.6 `PlaneGeometry` with a 256×102 canvas texture (deterministic wood-grain horizontal lines + dark brown border + 'The Holtwick Tavern' in cream serif) positioned at world `(gridOffset.x+32.5, 3, gridOffset.z+20.05)` so it hangs a hair south of the south wall outer face (TAVERN_ORIGIN_Z + TAVERN_INTERIOR_DEPTH + 2 = 20); faces south by default since PlaneGeometry's normal is +Z and +Z is south in this world. Lamp posts are 4 InstancedMesh cubes (shared 1×4×1 BoxGeometry, dark 0x2a2520 MeshStandardMaterial) at cells (29,4)/(29,12)/(29,44)/(29,52) — west edge of the N/S road (cx=32, PATH_HALF=3 → road x=29..35), 8-voxel spacing, z values picked to avoid tavern footprint (z=14..19) and plaza ring (z=22..41). Each lamp gets PointLight(0xfff0a0, 0, 6) at world y=4.8 (post top minus 0.2); intensity driven by `lampIntensityForPhase` — same `-cos(phase·2π)+0.3` curve the tavern/plaza lanterns use, capped at LAMP_MAX_INTENSITY=1.2 so the cluster ignites at dusk and peaks at midnight in lockstep with existing lanterns. `src/main.ts` mounts the sign + instanced post mesh + 4 PointLights, calls `updateLampPosts(lampPosts, dayNight.currentPhase)` once at boot and once per RAF tick right after `updateLanterns`; the `?test=1` `setDayNightPhase` hook now drives both update functions. New test hooks: `getLampIntensities()` returns 4 {label, intensity} entries; `hasTavernSign()` returns true when the mesh is parented to scene. `scripts/validate-visual.mjs` adds a P8.5 block just before the runtime-errors check that warps to phase 0.5 (midnight), asserts hasTavernSign + all 4 lamps lit + captures `iter-${ITER}-decorations.png`, restores phase 0. Build green 536.35 kB (+2.08 kB vs iter 47). Next: P8.6 (4 more item types — bread/apple/wooden_sword/wooden_shield).
